purpose: Punch one shocking phrase through flashing newspaper pages and lock it on the word
looks_like: One shocking phrase punches through flashing newspaper pages and locks on the exact spoken word; text must be the narration itself.
use_when: 'The judge called it a blunderbuss approach.' -> text (the phrase)
'And the cause of death was ruled a homicide.' -> text
'He had been dead for three weeks.' -> text
avoid_when: More than one phrase in the beat; a phrase over about 8 words; used on mundane statements.
Max twice per video; hold it for the single strongest line.

name: Lens Highlight
purpose: Sweep a marker over one to three key phrases on a typed page seen through a lens
looks_like: A marker sweeps over one to three key phrases on a typed page seen through a lens; the phrase must be spoken at least a moment into the beat and the piece needs a hold after.
use_when: 'The lawyers said the case was never about money.' -> text (1-3 phrases)
'The memo called the plan reckless, unauthorised and illegal.' -> text
'The terms said: no refunds, no exceptions, no appeals.' -> text
avoid_when: A beat under 4 s; a beat followed immediately by another piece (the hold can be refused); sentences with no key phrase to mark.
Failed in the Windows test when a piece was added to the next beat: check the gap after the last phrase.

name: Light Leak
purpose: Pass a warm flash over the footage as a reveal or section join
looks_like: A warm flash passes over the footage on the word that opens a new section; needs the member's own video.
use_when: 'And then everything changed.' -> source_video (a reveal or section join)
'Fast forward to the night of the premiere.' -> source_video
'That was day one. Day two was worse.' -> source_video
avoid_when: The flow has no own video; used more than once or twice; used together with the purple leak.
Pick one leak style per video; this is the warm default.

name: Purple Light Leak
purpose: Pass a purple-to-orange wash over the footage as a reveal or section join (use one leak style per video)
looks_like: A purple-to-orange wash passes over the footage as a reveal or section join; needs the member's own video.
use_when: 'And this is where it gets strange.' -> source_video
'Meanwhile, in a studio in Burbank.' -> source_video
'Three years later.' -> source_video
avoid_when: No member's own video; any video already using light_leak; weight 1, at most once.
Pick it over light_leak only when the video's colour is cool or purple.

name: Retro Footage
purpose: Turn the footage into VHS tape, a CRT screen or an old TV set for archive and found-tape moments
looks_like: Turns the footage into VHS tape, a CRT screen or an old TV set; needs the member's own video.
use_when: 'The tape from that night was recovered from a VHS cassette in her garage.' -> source_video
'Back in 1994 the whole city watched on grainy television.' -> source_video
'The old home video shows a young boy on a bike.' -> source_video
avoid_when: The sentence is about the present; no member's own video; a beat over 20 s.
Pairs with film_8mm for memories: pick retro_footage for tape or TV evidence, film_8mm for family memories.

name: Old 8mm Film
purpose: Roll footage or photos inside an old 8mm film frame for memories and backstory
looks_like: Rolls footage or photos inside an old 8mm film frame for memories and backstory; needs the member's own video.
use_when: 'As a child she spent summers on her grandmother's farm.' -> source_video (backstory)
'Home movies from 1978 show the family at the beach.' -> source_video
'The early years were simple: a small house, two parents, one dog.' -> source_video
avoid_when: Present-day or recent events; no member's own video; beat under 5 s.
Pick it for childhood and backstory; for tape or TV evidence use retro_footage.

name: Calendar Streak
purpose: Light up posting days on a month grid while a streak counter rolls
looks_like: Lights up posting days on a month grid while a streak counter rolls. The catalog marks it buildable:false, so the planner skips it.
use_when: 'He posted every single day for 90 days straight.' -> date + days
'Her upload streak ran from January to March without a gap.' -> date + days
'Miss one day and the streak goes back to zero.' -> date + days
avoid_when: Anything that is not about a streak or a posting habit; the engine cannot build it yet.
Never pick while buildable:false.

name: Timeline Track
purpose: Drop dated pins on a glowing track and move the camera from event to event
looks_like: Drops two to five dated pins on a glowing track and moves the camera from event to event; each pin needs a date and a label, and each pin needs about 1.5 s.
use_when: 'In March she filed, in June the judge ruled, in September they settled, and in December the case closed.' -> date + list_items (4 dated pins)
'The company was founded in 1998, went public in 2004 and collapsed in 2012.' -> date + list_items
'The driver crashed on lap 12, was pulled out by lap 15 and was dead by midnight.' -> date + list_items
avoid_when: Only one date (use date-center or date-slide); events with no dates; more than five events; beats under 6 s.
Dates are the point and photos are not available; with photos use photo-timeline.

name: History Sequence
purpose: Walk through dated moments with a photo card for each, on a drawn line or full bleed
looks_like: Walks through dated moments with a photo card for each on a drawn line or full bleed. The catalog marks it buildable:false, so the planner skips it.
use_when: '1998, the debut. 2003, the first title. 2010, the scandal. 2015, the return.' -> year + list_items + photos
'First came the first single, then the first tour, then the lawsuit.' -> year + list_items
'Napoleon crowned himself in 1804, invaded Russia in 1812 and fell in 1815.' -> year + list_items
avoid_when: The engine cannot build it yet; never pick while buildable:false. Use timeline_track or photo-timeline instead.
Beats under 6 s.
